items.html:
Actionable findings:

  • __init__.py:159: help(treams_rs) fails without optional dependencies because __dir__ advertises them and pydoc triggers lazy imports. Reproduced a ModuleNotFoundError for Advect. When installed, root help eagerly imports optional frameworks.
  • support.py:87: restricting class members to functions omits working OperatorAttribute methods such as TMatrix.efield, hfield, and translate; it also leaves all iterative.Solution, Gradient, and Convergence fields undocumented.
  • support.py:134: alias discovery misses lattice.area = volume, although lattice.area is a working public callable.

No edits. All 813 AST-derived signatures matched between Python 3.12 and 3.13.
